acceptanceCriteria.text: The displayed Kanban ticket count includes Backlog, In progress and Ready for review cards and excludes every completed/Done card.
Completing a card updates the displayed open count without requiring an app restart; refresh and deletion retain the correct count.
A board containing only completed cards displays zero open tickets, regardless of Done pagination; completed cards remain accessible in Done/history.
Behavioral regression tests and applicable delivery checks pass, and an actual desktop smoke check verifies the displayed count.

body:
## Source locations
- `src/renderer/src/kanban/useKanbanCounts.ts`: `useKanbanCounts` fetches boards and sums only the three open lanes (lines 35–37 already exclude Done). Investigate the reported display/refresh behavior; do not replace correct counting blindly.
- `src/renderer/src/kanban/useKanbanCounts.test.tsx`: existing mixed-lane exclusion regression; extend with completion refresh and all-Done cases.
- `src/renderer/src/app/useShell.ts`: owns the hook and folder event tokens used to refresh counts.
- `src/renderer/src/sidebar/Sidebar.tsx`: passes each folder count to the sidebar row.
- `src/renderer/src/App.sidebar.test.tsx`: existing sidebar integration assertion excludes a Done card.
- `src/renderer/src/kanban/KanbanBoard.tsx` and `useKanbanBoard.ts`: preserve Done lane totals/pagination; inspect if the reported count is on the board rather than sidebar.

## Outcome
The folder's Kanban ticket count represents open work, not historical completed cards. Completed cards must remain available in the Done lane/history but must not increase the displayed count.

## Scope
Locate the existing Kanban count calculation and its consumers. Count cards in Backlog, In progress and Ready for review; exclude Done. Apply the same rule wherever the Kanban ticket count is displayed. Preserve Done-lane contents and pagination. Update the count after completion, deletion and board refresh using existing state-update patterns. Do not change epic counts or card approval rules.

## Tests
Write a failing behavioral regression test before implementation using existing conventions: a mixed-lane board counts only open cards; completing an open card reduces the count; a board containing only completed cards shows zero. Ensure Done pagination does not affect the open count. Test observable counting/state behavior, not source text or incidental wording.

## Verification
Run targeted tests and the standalone delivery gate (lint, npm test, applicable Fireguard grading, typecheck, deadcode, build). Exercise the actual Kanban count in the desktop with mixed open/completed cards, verify completion updates the count, and confirm completed cards remain accessible. Record evidence and update existing relevant documentation/changelog. No implementation is authorized by this card-creation request.
expectedArtifacts: Corrected Kanban count calculation and affected display/state consumers
Behavioral regression tests and desktop verification evidence
title: Exclude completed cards from the Kanban ticket count
